{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# cachetools tagged cache handoff

Milestones 1-3 (R01-R08) implemented in src/cachetools/tagged.py.

Design notes:
- TaggedCache(maxsize, timer=None); timer defaults to time.monotonic.
- put(key, value, tags=(), ttl=None): validates tags (finite iterable of
  strings, no bare string, dedup) and ttl (None or finite nonnegative
  int/float, bool excluded) BEFORE any mutation. Values deep-copied in/out.
  Overwrite refreshes LRU recency and replaces tags + expiry.
- Expiry stored as absolute timer()+ttl per key in self.__expiry (name
  mangled). __purge_expired() runs before get/put/len/resize/invalidate/
  invalidate_many/pop; expired removal does not touch surviving recency.
  now >= expiry means expired (exact boundary expired; ttl=0 immediate).
- invalidate(tag), invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all'): empty tag
  request removes zero; invalid mode/tags raise ValueError pre-mutation;
  purge expired first so only live entries counted/removed.
- resize(maxsize): validates positive non-bool int first; purge expired;
  shrink evicts LRU via _TaggedLRUCache._resize (records evicted keys to
  prune tag memberships); grow no-op on entries; survivors keep values,
  tags, LRU order and absolute expiries.
- maxsize property reports current capacity. len() counts live entries.
- Existing cachetools APIs untouched (upstream tests unchanged, all pass).

Tests: tests/test_tagged.py (R01-R06), acceptance_public.py (basic,
replacement, union/resize, ttl). All pass: 313 in tests/, 101 tagged+public.
EOF
echo saved"}
